idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

args.summary: The latest deploy, v2.3.1, was unhealthy in production across all regions. Rollback to v2.3.0 was attempted first but rejected because v2.3.0 is quarantined (CVE-2026-4417). Rolled back to v2.2.9, the most recent healthy production release that is not quarantined, successfully rolled out to us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Service verified healthy post-rollback (error rate 0.2%). Remaining work: fix v2.3.1, and remediate CVE-2026-4417 before re-deploying any quarantined version.
args.title: checkout-api rolled back to v2.2.9 after unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy; v2.3.0 blocked by CVE-2026-4417 quarantine

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: v2.3.1 was the latest deploy and was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.
2. **Rollback attempt to v2.3.0 failed**: it's quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417.
3. **Rolled back to v2.2.9** (the next most recent healthy, non-quarantined production release) — successfully rolled out in us-east, us-west, and eu-west, and verified healthy afterward with a 0.2% error rate.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the rollback, the CVE quarantine that blocked v2.3.0, and follow-up items (fix v2.3.1, remediate CVE-2026-4417).
